source_documents.title: Constructing adaptive photosensitizers via supramolecular modification based on pillararene host−guest interactions

reference_evidence_units.quote: G has a small overlap between HOMO and LUMO
reference_evidence_units.subject: G
reference_evidence_units.statement: Separated donor/acceptor orbitals and a calculated singlet-triplet gap of 0.2 eV are used to propose efficient ISC for ROS production.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No ISC rate was measured in the inspected text; reported calculation is not a new inference experiment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the consumption of ABDA was calculated to be 4.5 nmol
reference_evidence_units.subject: G; Ce6 comparator
reference_evidence_units.conditions: G 30 micromolar, ABDA 5 nmol; white-light assay with probe photobleaching subtracted, Fig. 1a.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ABDA consumption is reported as 4.5 nmol with G in 140 s; comparator Ce6 gives 1.7 nmol in 300 s.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Different reported time points must be retained; ABDA consumption is not itself an absolute singlet-oxygen quantum yield.

reference_evidence_units.subject: G with WP5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: WP5 and G each 30 micromolar in aqueous medium, 5 min white-light irradiation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: WP5 complexation greatly reduces ROS-indicator consumption relative to G alone.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fluorescence and ROS need separate comparisons; the complex and free guest are not interchangeable states.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The consumption of ABDA was calculated to be 2.2 nmol in 300 s
reference_evidence_units.subject: G with WP5/P5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Host and G each 30 micromolar, pH 5.0, Fig. 1a.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Acidification restores ROS-indicator consumption to 2.2 nmol in 300 s, consistent with partial switching on.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not equate this value with the 4.5 nmol/140 s free-G result. Cell viability used pH 6.0 rather than 5.0.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Negligible change in fluorescence was observed after addition of WP5
reference_evidence_units.subject: G and G/host controls
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aqueous G 30 micromolar; WP5 30 micromolar; Fig. 2a-b.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Free G is weakly emissive; WP5 addition or acidification of G alone causes negligible fluorescence change, whereas acidification of G plus WP5 below pH 6 enhances emission strongly.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The abstract's generic quenching wording must not obscure that free G already has weak aqueous fluorescence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the alkyl chain was threaded into the cavity of WP5.
reference_evidence_units.subject: G with WP5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 1H NMR and NOE evidence reported from SI S10-S12.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Alkyl/pyridinium shifts and alkyl-host NOEs are interpreted as threading with carboxylate-pyridinium electrostatics, forming a pseudorotaxane.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; detailed binding geometry remains a source-supported interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Then photoinduced electron transfer (PET) happened between WP5 and G
reference_evidence_units.subject: G with WP5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neutral aqueous host-guest complex; source cites SI S13.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors invoke host-guest PET to suppress ROS generation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No direction, rate or direct kinetic evidence is established by the inspected main text; do not infer PET from fluorescence alone.

reference_evidence_units.quote: only NOE signals between protons Ha1,a2 on the endmost pyridinium unit of G and proton H1 on P5 were observed
reference_evidence_units.subject: G with protonated P5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: pH 5.0; SI S15/S16-S17 discussed in main text.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors interpret acidification as movement of protonated host to the terminal pyridinium, not complete host dissociation. Hydrophobic shielding leads to G/P5 coprecipitation and fluorescence enhancement; distance from TPE core permits ROS recovery.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; proposed shuttling model is not a crystal structure of this target complex. Cited analogous crystal structure is background.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the self-assemblies were changed to large aggregates
reference_evidence_units.subject: G and host-dependent assemblies
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text report of TEM SI S18: G, G/WP5 and acidic G/WP5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reported morphology changes from free-G vesicles to tiny particles with WP5, then large aggregates at pH 5.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: TEM itself not inspected; free-G vesicles complicate describing all aqueous G as exclusively molecularly dissolved.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Host-dependent coprecipitation and aggregate morphology underpin the fluorescence switch; it does not prove a specific internal RIM coordinate.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Central pH-dependent host binding/shuttling interpretation explains switching; not assumed host release.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source invokes donor-acceptor orbital separation to reduce the singlet-triplet gap. This is bounded electronic-structure support, not measured TICT kinetics.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit host-guest PET suppression of photosensitization and recovery after proposed relocation is retained with limited direct evidence.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source links small computed singlet-triplet gap and ISC to ROS photosensitization. This is a photosensitizer pathway, not phosphorescence or metal emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Main text connects aggregation to AIE but does not establish a target-specific restricted internal motion; no automatic RIM label.
